seed.rule: rho_seed = max(rho_canonical, 1e-3) on active cells; inactive unchanged
seed.why: the centered Path B bracket needs 0 < rho < 1 on active cells; the canonical design has large rho=0 regions

acceptance: controller merit/trust + bracket descent-sign match + real trial primal + volume
stop_conditions: a proposal that cannot form a symmetric centered pair is rejected, never clipped
no magnitude correction of the adjoint
